mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds rate at 0.21% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances despite FEDFUNDS <= 0.25%, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, it signals imminent Federal Reserve monetary policy easing, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of Federal Funds rate at or below 0.5% and unemployment rate at or above 9.0% signals deep recession with aggressive monetary policy response, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: deep recession with aggressive monetary policy
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS<=0.5 AND UNRATE>=9.0, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-recession recovery phase (defined by housing starts below 500 thousand units), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days as housing market stabilization improves consumer confidence and economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 500, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production is below its 2017 base level (100), it signals weak manufacturing sector, triggering Federal Reserve stimulus measures that drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index exceeds 215, it signals rising inflation triggering Federal Reserve tightening, which produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 215, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of rising inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215) and stable Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 0.2%) signals Federal Reserve failure to respond to inflation, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with inadequate monetary response
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL>215 AND FEDFUNDS>0.2, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 550 thousand units, it signals strengthening housing market, improving consumer confidence and economic activity, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST > 550, or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.
